title: Work, school and daily life
focus: 工作 公司 老师 学生 学校 上班 下班 开会 电脑 手机 问题 意思 准备 帮忙.
body:
# Work, school and daily life

You talk about work and school every day. This lesson puts characters to those words: the office, the classroom, the commute, and the things you say about them.

Many of these words come in pairs. Learn them together: once you can read 上班, you can read 下班, and 上课 / 下课 work the same way.

| Work | Pinyin | School | Pinyin |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公司 | gōngsī | 学校 | xuéxiào |
| 老板 · 同事 | lǎobǎn · tóngshì | 老师 · 学生 | lǎoshī · xuésheng |
| 上班 · 下班 | shàngbān · xiàbān | 上课 · 下课 | shàngkè · xiàkè |
| 开会 · 加班 | kāihuì · jiābān | 考试 · 作业 | kǎoshì · zuòyè |
| 工资 · 出差 | gōngzī · chūchāi | 放假 · 毕业 | fàngjià · bìyè |
| 办公室 | bàngōngshì | 请假 | qǐngjià |

**Shared parts:** 班 (shift, class) appears in 上班, 下班 and 加班. 课 (lesson) appears in 上课 and 下课. 假 (time off) appears in 请假 and 放假.

## Examples

- 你在哪儿工作? nǐ zài nǎr gōngzuò: Where do you work?
- 我明天不用上班。 wǒ míngtiān búyòng shàngbān: I don't have to go to work tomorrow.
- 老板在开会。 lǎobǎn zài kāihuì: The boss is in a meeting.
- 今天又要加班。 jīntiān yòu yào jiābān: Overtime again today.
- 你几点下班? nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàbān: What time do you get off work?
- 对不起,我迟到了。 duìbuqǐ, wǒ chídào le: Sorry, I'm late.
- 他是我同事。 tā shì wǒ tóngshì: He's my colleague.
- 明天有考试,我还没准备。 míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, wǒ hái méi zhǔnbèi: There's a test tomorrow and I haven't prepared.
- 你作业写完了吗? nǐ zuòyè xiěwán le ma: Have you finished your homework?
- 你能帮个忙吗? nǐ néng bāng ge máng ma: Can you give me a hand?
- 她今年大学毕业。 tā jīnnián dàxué bìyè: She graduates from university this year.

## Common mistakes

- **准 vs 谁.** 准 (zhǔn) has two drops 冫 on the left; 谁 (shéi) has 讠 speech. The right side 隹 is the same.
- **One character, two readings.** 假 is jià in 请假 and 放假 (time off) but jiǎ in 假的 (fake). 差 is chāi in 出差 but chà in 差不多.

cards.Example: 你在哪儿工作? nǐ zài nǎr gōngzuò: Where do you work?
cards.Notes: 作 = 亻 + 乍 zhà; lookalike 昨 (zuó, yesterday) has 日 instead

cards.Example: 他们公司很大。 tāmen gōngsī hěn dà: Their company is big.
cards.Notes: 司 (sī) is open on the left; 同 (tóng) is closed on both sides

cards.Example: 王老师今天不在。 Wáng lǎoshī jīntiān bú zài: Teacher Wang isn't in today.
cards.Notes: 师 vs 帅 (shuài, handsome): 师 has an extra stroke across the top right

cards.Example: 他们都是学生。 tāmen dōu shì xuésheng: They're all students.
cards.Notes: 学 has ⺍ + 冖 on top of 子; 字 (zì) has the roof 宀 instead

cards.Example: 学校离我家很近。 xuéxiào lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn: The school is close to my home.
cards.Notes: 校 = 木 tree + 交 jiāo for the sound

cards.Example: 我明天不用上班。 wǒ míngtiān búyòng shàngbān: I don't have to work tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 班 = two 王 split by a knife stroke in the middle

cards.Example: 你几点下班? nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàbān: What time do you get off work?
cards.Notes: Same 班 as 上班 and 加班

cards.Example: 老板在开会。 lǎobǎn zài kāihuì: The boss is in a meeting.
cards.Notes: 会 is also read kuài in 会计 (accountant)

cards.Example: 我的电脑坏了。 wǒ de diànnǎo huài le: My computer is broken.
cards.Notes: Literally 'electric brain'; 脑 has 月 (body part); 恼 nǎo (annoyed) has 忄

cards.Example: 我手机没电了。 wǒ shǒujī méi diàn le: My phone's out of battery.
cards.Notes: 机 = 木 + 几 jī for the sound; literally 'hand machine'

cards.Example: 没问题。 méi wèntí: No problem.
cards.Notes: 问 = 门 door + 口 mouth; 题 = 是 + 页 (page)

cards.Example: 这是什么意思? zhè shì shénme yìsi: What does this mean?
cards.Notes: Both characters have 心 heart at the bottom

cards.Example: 你准备好了吗? nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma: Are you ready?
cards.Notes: 准 has two drops 冫 on the left, not three 氵

cards.Example: 你能帮个忙吗? nǐ néng bāng ge máng ma: Can you give me a hand?
cards.Notes: 忙 = 忄 heart + 亡 wáng for the sound; 帮 has 巾 cloth at the bottom

cards.Example: 他是我同事。 tā shì wǒ tóngshì: He's my colleague.
cards.Notes: 事: one vertical stroke runs through the whole character

cards.Example: 老板今天心情不好。 lǎobǎn jīntiān xīnqíng bù hǎo: The boss is in a bad mood today.
cards.Notes: 板 = 木 wood + 反 fǎn for the sound

cards.Example: 今天又要加班。 jīntiān yòu yào jiābān: Overtime again today.
cards.Notes: 加 = 力 strength + 口 mouth

cards.Example: 我明天想请假。 wǒ míngtiān xiǎng qǐngjià: I want to take tomorrow off.
cards.Notes: 假 is jià (time off) here but jiǎ in 假的 (fake)

cards.Meaning: be on holiday, have a break
cards.Example: 学校下个星期放假。 xuéxiào xià ge xīngqī fàngjià: School is off next week.
cards.Notes: 放 = 方 fāng for the sound + 攵 (hand action)

cards.Example: 八点上课。 bā diǎn shàngkè: Class starts at eight.
cards.Notes: 课 = 讠 speech + 果 guǒ; 下课 means class is over

cards.Example: 明天有考试。 míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì: There's a test tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 考 vs 老: same top, but 考 ends in 丂 and 老 in 匕

cards.Example: 你作业写完了吗? nǐ zuòyè xiěwán le ma: Have you finished your homework?
cards.Notes: 业 vs 亚 (yà, as in 亚洲): 亚 has an extra line across the top

cards.Example: 她今年大学毕业。 tā jīnnián dàxué bìyè: She graduates from university this year.
cards.Notes: 毕 = 比 bǐ for the sound + 十

cards.Example: 老师在办公室。 lǎoshī zài bàngōngshì: The teacher is in the office.
cards.Notes: 室 = 宀 roof + 至; 办 has two dots either side of 力

cards.Example: 这个月工资还没发。 zhège yuè gōngzī hái méi fā: This month's pay hasn't come yet.
cards.Notes: 资 = 次 cì for the sound + 贝 shell (money)

cards.Example: 对不起,我迟到了。 duìbuqǐ, wǒ chídào le: Sorry, I'm late.
cards.Notes: 迟 = 辶 walk + 尺 chǐ; 到 = 至 + 刂 dāo for the sound

cards.Example: 我爸去上海出差了。 wǒ bà qù Shànghǎi chūchāi le: My dad's away in Shanghai on business.
cards.Notes: 差 is chāi here, chà in 差不多, chā in 差别

cards.Meaning: The meeting is at nine tomorrow morning.
cards.Notes: 点 (o'clock) has four dots 灬 at the bottom

cards.Pinyin: lǎoshī, wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí
cards.Notes: 一 is read yí before 个

cards.Pinyin: wǒ xiàbān le, nǐ zài nǎr
cards.Meaning: I'm off work. Where are you?
cards.Notes: 哪 (nǎ, where/which) adds 口 to 那 (nà, that)
